summary.text: Jay Adams is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 96 since January 1, 2015, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Adams earned a B.S. in education from The Citadel.
His professional experience includes working as a real estate broker, for SIECOR as a technical communications specialist, and for Deville Furniture.

He has served on the City of Hickory's Brownfield Advisory Group and on boards and committees of the Catawba County Chamber of Commerce, the Western Piedmont Council of Governments and the City of Hickory.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Adams as chair of the Wildlife Resources Committee, vice chair of the House Transportation Committee, and a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations on Transportation, Commerce, Education - Community Colleges, and Local Government - Land Use, Planning and Development committees.
